bull.b: The lead neuroendocrine-tumor program is producing encouraging efficacy and safety signals across a meaningful patient dataset. Durable disease control, objective responses and no treatment-related discontinuations support continued development and could improve the program’s prospects for later-stage advancement.

A multi-program 212Pb platform and integrated infrastructure can create durable strategic advantages if clinical results continue to validate the approach. Regional production, direct delivery and intellectual-property coverage may support reliable commercialization and differentiation across oncology indications.

The reported cash position provides funding visibility through planned clinical and operational milestones into late 2027, reducing immediate financing pressure. That runway gives management time to advance multiple programs, prepare for Phase 3 activity and expand manufacturing before requiring additional capital.

bear.b: Very small and volatile revenue, including prior periods with zero reported revenue, shows that the company has not yet established commercial scale. Persistent operating and net losses indicate the current cost structure remains far ahead of revenue generation and profitability.

Sustained negative operating and free cash flow means clinical progress is consuming substantial liquidity rather than internally funding growth. Unless profitability improves, continued outflows can reduce the available runway and make future development dependent on additional financing or other capital sources.

The principal programs remain in early clinical development, so encouraging interim data have not yet established registration or commercial success. Moving into Phase 3 will require further validation of efficacy, safety and execution, leaving material development uncertainty over the next several quarters.
